top_signals.title: Gold Rebounds as Dip-Buyers Step In After Worst Week Since March
top_signals.summary: Gold rebounded from its biggest weekly decline in eight months, with dip-buyers stepping in as the market pared bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
